name: Sunosawa Mishio
source:
A woman who works as an animal caretaker in a zoo. 

A very lively and upfront girl who loves animals more than anything else. 

Among the animals she takes care of, she's especially close to Boro, a tundra wolf. The two deeply trusts each other. 

However, her unsuspecting nature lead to her ruin when the zoo director successfully caught her in a trap, and had her perform at the zoo's night bestiality program.

[Translated from [url=http://cyc-soft.com/cyclet_pro/dobutuen/chara01.html]Official Site[/url]]
